PNEUMA II

Mağaza Tasarımı · Mersin · 2025. A Parfumlab store in Mersin, built on the pneumatic display system. Retail Design, Mersin. TUNK: İstanbul mimarlık, sergi tasarımı ve enstalasyon ofisi.

A Parfumlab store completed in Mersin as part of the retail programme. The interior extends the Pneuma language — a wall of vertical tubes carrying perfume bottles like a pneumatic system, a tiled counter and a family of display plinths — tuned to the footprint of this location.
